o: terms of employment are regular and registered
e: The Act that guarantees 100 days of rural employment — MGNREGA 2005.

q: The organised sector is one where:
o: terms of employment are regular and registered
e: The organised sector is one where — terms of employment are regular and registered.

q: The four factors of production:
o: land, labour, physical capital and human capital
minimum level of food and other needs
e: The four factors of production — land, labour, physical capital and human capital.

q: The organisation that sets rules for international trade:
e: The organisation that sets rules for international trade — World Trade Organization (WTO).

q: The sector that includes banking, transport and trade:
e: The sector that includes banking, transport and trade — tertiary (service) sector.

q: The Green Revolution mainly increased production of:
e: The Green Revolution mainly increased production of — wheat and rice.

q: The right that lets consumers know details of a product:
e: The right that lets consumers know details of a product — right to information.

q: A situation where both parties want what the other has:
e: A situation where both parties want what the other has — double coincidence of wants.

q: The sector that includes manufacturing:
e: The sector that includes manufacturing — secondary sector.

q: Security against a loan, such as land or gold:
o: land, labour, physical capital and human capital
minimum level of food and other needs
e: Security against a loan, such as land or gold — collateral.

q: Buffer stock of food grains is maintained by:
o: land, labour, physical capital and human capital
e: Buffer stock of food grains is maintained by — Food Corporation of India (FCI).

q: The value of all final goods and services produced in a country in a year:
e: The value of all final goods and services produced in a country in a year — Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

q: The sector owned by the government:
e: The sector owned by the government — public sector.

q: Removing barriers on foreign trade and investment:
o: minimum level of food and other needs
e: Removing barriers on foreign trade and investment — liberalisation.

q: Special Economic Zones are set up to:
e: Special Economic Zones are set up to — attract foreign companies to invest.
